_readme: Real Google reviews for Captain Levi's Fiberglass, Boat Repair, & Boat Detailing (Google Maps listing, 11600 66th St N, Largo FL). Pulled verbatim from the listing on 2026-10-22: 178 reviews, 4.7 average (165 five-star, 2 three-star, 11 one-star). Dates are the relative dates Google showed on that day. reviews.html renders the five-star reviews that have text; everything else is kept here so nothing is invented or dropped. Re-pull from Google and bump 'fetched' when refreshing. Never add a review that is not on the Google listing.

reviews.name: matthew mefferd
reviews.text: The staff was fantastic and conscientious of our repair needs. We had a through hole leak and they came out to our home, removed it, patched the fiberglass and reinstalled new parts for us. They checked and double checked to be sure it was fixed to our liking. Great company. Would use them again.

reviews.name: Michael Einstein
reviews.text:
Captain Levy Levi’s Fiberglass boat repair and Detailing has taken care of my yacht for approximately six years, Detailing, expert perfect match gelcoat repairs, hurricane and collision Fiberglass Work rubber Burrill repair and they did it Mobley at Snug Harbor Marine.

My boat is a 40 foot cabin cruiser kept on Boca Ciega Bay and it suffered damage during three separate hurricanes

Capt. Dave worked with progressive insurance and three different adjusters three different claims and got it all worked out and all it cost me was the deductible

Dave has always been knowledgeable dependable experience in fiberglass repair. I highly recommend Boat gel. Kote and Repair needs.

reviews.name: Bryan Swan
reviews.text:
I've been in the commercial fishing and boat transport industry for more than 15 years, and I've known Captain Dave Holley for most of that time. His knowledge of fiberglass boat repair, structural fiberglass fabrication, custom boat modifications, and marine construction is second to none. When it comes to strength, durability, functionality, and long-term reliability, Captain Dave's expertise is unmatched in the marine industry.
One project that stands out was when Captain Dave designed and fabricated a custom fiberglass bow pulpit from scratch for my commercial fishing vessel. The modification allowed my anchor chute system to safely handle over 35 feet of anchor chain and a 35pound commercial fishing anchor. The improvement increased both operational efficiency and onboard safety, making a significant difference in our daily fishing operations.
What sets Captain Dave apart is not only his technical skill but also his professionalism, communication, and ability to work closely with clients to achieve the best possible outcome. Whether you need mobile fiberglass boat repair, structural fiberglass repairs, custom fiberglass fabrication, gelcoat repair, collision damage repair, deck repairs, transom repairs, or commercial fishing vessel modifications, I can recommend Captain Levi's Fiberglass Boat Repair without hesitation. In an industry filled with experienced craftsmen, Captain Dave stands apart as a true titan of the fiberglass and marine repair industry.
His decades of hands-on experience, problemsolving ability, and commitment to doing the job right have earned him the respect of commercial fishermen, boat transport professionals, and boat owners throughout Florida. Captain Dave has earned a reputation as one of the most knowledgeable fiberglass repair specialists in Florida. I have the highest respect for him and look forward to continuing both our friendship and professional relationship for years to come. If you're looking for quality workmanship, honest advice, and repairs built to last, Captain Levi's Fiberglass Boat Repair is the company to call.
Bryan Swan Commercial Fisherman & Boat Transport Professional Pinellas County, Florida

reviews.name: Anthony Grieco
reviews.text: A while back the captain did some fiberglass repair on one of my lawn spray trucks and they turned out great. I wouldn't hesitate to use his services again. Quick turn around and very fair pricing.

reviews.name: Lauren Clark
reviews.text: Due to the hurricane on the other side of the Gulf in July (which pulled water out of the area), we hit something under the water (which we wouldn't have normally if waters were at regular depths) and it did some hull damage. We looked for places online to leave it since we were coming back in a month. When we called Capt. Levi's and talked to Capt. Dave he said he could fix it in that time frame. They also fix the jet ski rentals in the area so leaving our Yamaha Waverunner Cruiser would be in good hands. We picked it up on Aug. 9 and it looked like new! HIGHLY recommend this place! Rode in the area several days this week and had a blast!

reviews.name: Mark Kercher
reviews.text: Captain Levi knows everything about boats and treats customers with great respect and no BS. He gave me sound advice about my boat when most boat repair shops would have padded their prices up on number of hours/rates and gladly taken me to the cleaners. Captain Levi shot me straight and I appreciated his honesty.

reviews.name: Nate J
reviews.text: Captain Dave was very generous with his time discussing estimates of repairs and his recommendations related to fuel tanks. Very thoughtful and helpful!

reviews.name: Mark Lipscomb
reviews.text: Nicest guy on the phone. Looks to have a good satisfaction rating. My experience was different he committed to looking at my boat at a yard in Tampa and giving me a quote. I have called him, texted him and emailed him several times and have not gotten a response. I thought maybe the company had closed but the business number still rings through. Hard to do business with people that don’t show up.

reviews.name: A K
reviews.text: The Captain has the best repair experience and customer service around. He helped me, a new boat owner launch and work on my boat. You can expect good work and reasonable pricing!

reviews.name: Langston Mlinar
reviews.text:
Moving to a new place always comes with its share of surprises—especially when you have a boat that needs some TLC. I recently found myself in Tampa Bay, all the way from Wisconsin, and my little boat was crying out for a new rub rail and some minor gel coat repairs. Not exactly the welcome I’d hoped for.

So, I started searching around for a reliable boat repair service, something local and trustworthy. That’s when I stumbled upon Boatyard Captain Levi’s. Honestly, I wasn’t expecting much at first, just hoping for a decent job. But I’m really glad I gave them a shot.

From the moment I got in touch, the team was friendly and professional—they understood exactly what my boat needed, and they handled everything with care. The rub rail replacement was flawless, and the gel coat touch-ups brought my boat back to life in no time. It felt like they treated my boat as if it were their own.

As someone new to Tampa Bay, finding a dependable local service made all the difference. It’s comforting to know there are folks like Captain Levi and his crew nearby, ready to help keep your boat—and your peace of mind—in great shape.

If you’re ever in this area and need quality boat work done without the hassle, I’d recommend looking them up. It’s these small, local gems that turn a new place into a home.

reviews.name: Reinaldo Claudio
reviews.text: True craftsmanship and old school customer service. My new boat was loaded on a trailer for detailing. Needless to say what happened when you see the photos. I was never told and the detailers tried to cover the damage with cheap filler. You can imagine my disappointment when I first saw the cover up. Captain Levi was high class from the first call. He made the arrangements with the marina and made the repairs out of his mobile unit. I think the photos speak by themselves. You can not tell where was the original damage. He gave me an estimate based on my photos and the estimated work time. The estimate was very reasonable to begin with but It took him less time than it was foreseen and he adjusted the fee accordingly. How often do you see that? and did I mention that I still have not met him in person as my scheduled did not allow me. Everything was handled flawlessly through email and phone call. I highly recommend this company and I would trust this man my boat any day.

reviews.name: Joshua Taylor
reviews.text: I initially made contact with Dave via telephone and he asked if I could email over the pictures to get an idea of the damage that needed repair. He promptly replied and said that the job cost would be approximately $400. I dropped the boat off and met Capt. Dave and Darren; they both seemed very knowledgeable in their craft. I stuck around to watch the repairs and I have a new appreciation for the work that is involved when making gel-coat repairs. The preparation, sanding, coloring, spraying etc… It’s a very involved process, and I can completely understand why you need a professional. If you are looking for honest work at a good price, give Capt. Dave a call.

reviews.name: Captain USA
reviews.text: My hull was pretty beat up. One call, a few snap shots from my phone, and the following day Captain Dave visited me to have a look. Within minutes I had quote in hand. They got it in quickly and returned it a few days later, looking new again. Great crew, reasonable prices, and top notch work. Look at that shine! Captain Levi's is a family run business that loves what they do and takes pride in every job, no matter how big or small. Thank you Captain Dave and Levi. You are the best!

reviews.name: Michelle W
reviews.text: Hand down the best fiberglass work and detailing that I have ever experienced. Capt Dave and his staff are absolutely wonderful and do the best work in town and beyond.

reviews.name: Brian Ward
reviews.text:
What a great job Captain Dave did on my 223 Formula!

Was a I/O. Filled in the transom, added big knees from the transom and tied it all together. New plastic floors, fuel tank, and paint. Installed stainless marine outboard bracket.
Made a 50 year old boat better than brand new.
This is my third Formula and the best one yet.
I have known Capt. Dave Holley for 50 years. He used to work for my father-in-law, Tommy Carr.

I can't say enough about his super work and very fair prices.
Thank you Capt. Dave!

reviews.name: Douglas Barnard
reviews.text:
If you need knowledgeable, prompt and professional marine repairs, services and/or storage at a fair price.....look no further! I was in a real bind (had literally one day to relocate my boat and get it off the trailer) this year trying to find a safe place to store and repair my 36 foot offshore boat. It is a very unique project that I've been working on for the last year and a half. Capt. Dave quoted me an EXTREMELY fair price compared to the other outfits in town even knowing I didn't have many/any other options due to the high demand because of the hurricanes last year. He pulled in a full crew and had the boat "blocked up" in the yard and ready for continued refurbishment in ONE DAY!
He also gave me some great free advice the unquestionably saved me considerable time and money.
As someone who has been power boating, fishing and sailing for over fifty years, I found his broad knowledge of the marine industry, repairs and even commercial fishing truly impressive and believe me, I've been bullshitted and bent over by the worst of them.
From day one, he treated me like family and his word is as good as gold. They also have full time security on-site. I give them my highest recommendation and can't thank them enough. Disregard the ignorant "tire kickers" that gave him a negative review and give them a call. You won't regret it.

reviews.name: Roland Sanchez
reviews.text: I had my 26ft Mako Hull repaired and repainted Stark White with new Rub Rails installed And I was really impressed and very satisfied with the Quality I highly recommend getting work done at this Boat shop

reviews.name: Thomas Foxhill
reviews.text: I brought my boat in for some fiberglass repairs. Captain Dave was a pleasure to work with thru and thru. I emailed some pictures and received an estimate that was affordable and paired up with the final bill. Captain Dave is extremely knowledgeable and got my boat done as promised. I would definitely recommend him for your fiberglass needs.

reviews.name: Hunter Bray
reviews.text: Captain Dave was great to work with. I talked to him on the phone one morning, dropped it off that afternoon and had it back within a week despite all the afternoon thunderstorms. The bottom of the boat was cleaned and even gave my trailer attention in a couple spots that he noticed as well. Would recommend his service to anyone needing work on fiberglass or repairs.

reviews.name: Jonathan Tavio
reviews.text: I recently had the pleasure of using Captain Levi's fiberglass after damage to my sailboat endured by hurricane Milton. From the moment I reached out, Captain Dave was exceptionally professional, responsive, and incredibly helpful. Captain Dave always went above and beyond to assist me, including resolving an insurance headache! I am grateful to have come across captain Levi's fiberglass boat repair. I will be returning for all future needs and highly recommend them to anyone looking for top notch service. It's rare to find a company that genuinely cares about their customers- and this one is one!

reviews.name: Cheryl Benedict
reviews.text: They were awesome. I posted the before pics, I don't have after pics because I can't pinpoint exactly where the gashes were, you can't tell they were ever there. They even replaced a broken seat back with marine grade plywood - as you can see, my attempt at repair was an epic fail. Captain Dave was awesome, I highly recommend them! They were very responsive, they replied almost immediately to my emails.

reviews.name: Michelle Olsen
reviews.text: Had small fiberglass repair on a gheenoe. Super nice guy, easy to work with and any issues after the fact said to call him.

reviews.name: Eric Oliva
reviews.text: New location on 66th St in Largo. This was a great experience. Captain Dave was easy to work with and responsive by phone and text. He initially provided me a fair quote based on photos I sent and then completed the work promptly. I received the boat back same day. I appreciated how he introduced me to Wilson, who did the gel coat repairs, and kept the same guy on the project for consistency. Thanks again Captain Dave. I hope I don’t need you again, but if i need some fiberglass work I know where to go.

reviews.name: Thomas Kras
reviews.text: Had my Scout repaired for keel damage at Captain Levi's. I could not be happier with the repair made and the outstanding customer service I received. Captain Dave and his crew did an excellent job! The repair was priced right. Along with the repair, Captain Dave helped me resolve a leaking fuel line issue which made me feel like an old friend. If you like great customer service fair prices and quality fiberglass repair, I recommend Captain Levi's to get the job done right. Thanks again Captain Dave!

reviews.name: Kevin Sullivan
reviews.text: We just moved to St Pete and I needed to get my Boston Whaler bottom painted. A neighbor recommended Captain Levi's so I called them. I promptly got a call back from Captain Dave. He was able to take my boat the next day. Captain Dave is extremely knowledgeable and his team was very friendly and professional. The work was completed in the timeframe Captain Dave committed to. The quality of the work was excellent and the price very fair. I also had the boat detailed by Captain Dave's team and it looks great! I would recommend Captain Levi's to anyone needing fiberglass work on their boat.

reviews.name: Mike Kavallierakis
reviews.text: brought my boat in to captain Levi's with a soft transom ..... 10 minutes with Dave he walked m thru how bad my glass was and what needed to be done. after agreeing on price Dave had his crew de lam my transom new board and glass and re lammed in ... I think I can add 100 hp on my next motor my transom is so strong !!! Dave and crew was so great and professional in their work I decided to paint and re rig boat with them !!! if you need boat work come down to see Dave at captain Levi's you will not be disappointed !!!!!HIGHLY RECCOMEND

reviews.name: Bill Ramsey
reviews.text: Captain Dave and his team did a great job repairing my damaged Jet Ski. Very professional and informative along the repair process.

reviews.name: Jay Allison
reviews.text: I was very pleased to find Captain Levi’s in my search to get gel coat repairs done to my boat. They quickly provided an estimate via photos and then provided service at my house. The work was flawless and cannot even tell where the damage was. Thanks Captain Levi !

reviews.name: Faith Yount
reviews.text:
Captain Levi and his crew are amazing! They went above and beyond on our boat. When we brought the boat to the Captain Levi’s fiberglass repair shop, our boat was on its last leg. Honesty, they brought the boat back to life. They refurbished the deck with beautiful marine plywood. After that, the fiberglass work was spectacular. Finally they detailed our boat.. what a difference. The work on our boat was done so professionally. His employees were super nice, and always had a smile on their faces. You knew that loved their job and enjoyed helping you and your boat. Captain Levi loves his job too. He also always had a smile on his face. We knew straight away we were in good hands. He was always honest and always right on. He was knowledgeable about every aspect of the boat. As well as the trailer! We are so happy we chose Captain Levi’s to fix our boat. I don’t think we would of had the same type of experience we had with Levi and his crew if we decided to go to another fiberglass repair shop.
Thank you Captain Levi! And many thank yous to your crew as well!

reviews.name: Scott Holkeboer
reviews.text: I don't typically write reviews but I had to write one due to the exceptional level of service I received from Capt. Levi's. Captain Dave repaired a few fiberglass dings and gel coat breaks on my boat this week, and he did a very quality job. What really set them apart though is that there were a couple of issues that occurred (not their fault) that delayed finishing the job. Captain Dave kept me very informed and updated a couple of times per day on the delay, and you just find that level of communication anymore. Quality work, dependable service, and very friendly. 5+ stars

reviews.name: Joe Piemonte
reviews.text: Highly recommended! I had a complete exterior refinish done on my heavily-oxidized navy blue 2012 Sea Hunt BX24. Captain Dave and his crew reconditioned the gel coat, and applied new logos and boot stripe; painted the Yahama engine cowling and applied new decals; and even painted the lower unit free of charge. Then they finished everything with an interior detail. The boat looks brand new!!! Very happy with the work! And, Captain Dave is an interesting and entertaining guy to talk to! Great experience, reasonable price.

reviews.name: Harry Laney
reviews.text: I just want to thank Capt Dave and his crew over there at Captain Levi's Fiberglass Boat! They did a great job on my 1970 Scottie Craft. I had twin small block chevys removed, with all fiberglass repair work done filling in two large holes, misc repair and my boat prepared for a single engine. All fiberglass work was done in a reasonable amount of time and beautifully finished. Capt Dave and his crew also cleaned up the outside gel coat and bottom painted the boat. All my friends couldn't believe it's the same boat when they finished. People who admire my boat, can't believe the boat their looking at, is over 45 years old! On top of that, he went out of his way to find me other professionals to install my new mercury inboard outboard, that not only did they do an excellent job, but also, save me a lot of money having the mechanical work done professionally. Capt. Dave is an up front and honest man and a new friend of mine. Like he said, the work won't be done till I was happy and I am. Can't wait to get out on the water and enjoy my boat! Thank you again, Capt. Dave and your magical employees!

reviews.name: Stephanie Chamberlain
reviews.text: Captain Dave was amazing. I would recommend the guys at Captain Levi's to everyone who is looking for watercraft repairs. Not only do our jet skis look brand new and the price was beyond honest and fair. He made the experience of having to get them fixed as painless as possible. They went as far as picking them up and dropping them off from my home. They did fantastic work and were a delight to work with. Thanks again to Captain Dave. :)

reviews.name: Devon Allison
reviews.text: I am not a boat person. I took my boat to Captain Levi's to have it detailed and made ready for sale. Captain Dave was extremely helpful! He responded to texts and phone calls promptly. He saw how uncomfortable I was with towing the boat home and had a driver do it for me! The boat looks great and I couldn't be happier with them. I would highly recommend Captain Levi's!!

reviews.name: richard jamin
reviews.text: The guys at Capt Levi’s were off the chart good. I have 13 foot Boston Whaler that had several cracks in the boat and water was saturating the hull. They were able to dry it out and make repairs that are perfect. Highly recommend Capt Levi for all your fiberglass boat repairs.

reviews.name: John McCarrell
reviews.text: I had some significant fiberglass / gelcoat damage in need of repair. I was also looking for someone mobile that could effect repairs while the boat was on the lift. After checking reviews and calling around I landed on Captain Levi's. Great communication was a huge plus. Jose responded to my house and got the boat looking like new in no time. Please doing business with these folks.

reviews.name: Kurt Badertscher
reviews.text: Captain Levi and his team were outstanding. I called him to discuss my issues. He told me to email him some pictures so he can gain a better understanding of my problem. I have a 21' pontoon boat that required and new deck. He evaluated the pictures and gave me an estimate to repair the deck. We agreed on the price. His price was very detailed. He delivered my beautifully repaired boat back to me in a very timely manner. Great experience with a reasonable price!

reviews.name: Drew Butler
reviews.text: I reached out to Captain Dave to look into repairing some trailer damage on the bow of my 2002 Maverick Master Angler. I emailed over a few pics to him and within an hour had a budget proposal. I met up with Captain Dave the next morning and he and his team began working right away. The repair was fantastic and matched perfectly. You can not tell there was ever any damage. They also compounded the sides of my fighting lady yellow hull and brought back the original luster. I am very pleased with the work and really enjoyed working with Captain Dave. I would highly recommend him and his team to anyone looking for any type of fiberglass repair, restoration or detailing.

reviews.name: Chris Gorman
reviews.text: I bought a boat with a few fiberglass issues and after a few years I decided to get it fixed. I found Capt Levi’s and Capt Dave. They not only repaired my issue but also did additional repairs on similar damage that I didn’t even realize was there. Very good work done in a short period of time. Thank you guys and I look forward to referring more business and will definitely work with you again.

reviews.name: Susan Savage
reviews.text: I am a new resident to Florida. The main reason for my move was to do more boating and fishing. I purchased a new center console boat and wanted the bottom painted. I found Dave of Captain Levi's on line and made a call. I spoke to Dave at length about my boat and intentions. It was immediately apparent, the man knew what he was talking about. He's honest, sincere and made me feel comfortable about my decisions because of his knowledge, not only in the fiberglass repair business, but boating in general. If you need fiberglass work or painting done on your boat, there's only one person I would recommend, and that's Dave of Captain Levi's! It's my best find in the State of Florida so far!

reviews.name: Alexander Rahmings
reviews.text:
I recently purchased a new to me 08' 29' Regulator Center console. We took it out on a trip and upon returning to the boat ramp and loading her up she sustained some damage to the bottom from our trailer. I was referred to Captain Levis by my electronics installer. I contacted and spoke to the owner, Captain Dave and sent him pics of the damage. He gave me a very reasonable quote soon thereafter and made a point to get our boat in for the repair. In less than a week we were back on the water. In addition to completing the repair which is now totally unnoticeable with matching gelcoat color, he also cleaned up a few chips here and there. If you are looking for any fiberglass/gelcoat repairs this is the only choice in my opinion. Great person, excellent work and very reasonable prices.
Thanks Captain Dave!

reviews.name: DanLoretta Fricks
reviews.text: Worked with Captain Levi's for new bottom paint, rub rail replacement, and gel coat repairs. I was pleased with all aspects of their work from start to finish. Captain Dave and his crew were very friendly, do quality work at a fair price, and completed the job in a timely manner. I would definitely recommend Captain Levi's.

reviews.name: Michele Smith
reviews.text: When we moved to St. Petersburg from Connecticut we didn't really know anyone locally. Once we got our 28 foot Boston Whaler Outrage down here we visited several marinas in search a qualified and dependable boat repair person. We were so happy to find Capt. Levi and his crew. Our boat needed a lot of work as the cold weather and transport here pounded the boat pretty bad. Capt. Levi did an exceptional job in many repairs and in detailing. We wouldn't use anyone else and trust him like family! His experience in the industry and his respect for professionalism are outstanding. We are so happy we found them and now use them all the time for boat needs, not to mention for all our other various needs with our dock and fishing needs. We strongly recommend Capt. Levi's and refer people to him at every opportunity. Michele & Michael :o)

reviews.name: Rick Gilbert
reviews.text: Captain Dave was referred to my by my Doctor as a most reputable mechanic. I have a Larson Cabrio 330 with a step hull that was damaged for many months by the previous owner and his marina. The step on both sides of the hull was waterlogged because of the damage and had to air out for 4 days before Dave would make the repair. He opened up the step, grinded out the bad glass and made a great repair that I am sure will be everlasting. I am so pleased with the job, the attitude of him and his workers and the cost. The job was done on my boat in my driveway and it was spotless when they left. Thanks again Captain Dave.

reviews.name: Linda Tisdale
reviews.text: I highly recommend Captain Levi's. Dave was very responsive and got our boat in for fiberglass repair the same week we called and finished the job in one day. Talk about fast service! We were very happy the quality of the repair work as well, just like it never happened.

reviews.name: Leo Compton
reviews.text:
Great job !! We were refered by a neighbor that was really happy with some hull repair that Captain Dave had done. We called and made arrangements to have a first time bottom paint job done on our 23' key west, he was unbelievably accommodating. He used his own trailor to get our boat, gave us fair pricing and the paint came out fantastic. 10 months later, the bottom had to be re-painted because of a bad batch of the epoxy coat, Captain Dave took our boat back and re epoxied and painted the hull....Free of charge! Excellent customer service and quality work. We will always take our boats to Captain Dave.
Thank you Captain Dave.

reviews.name: Brian Gearhart
reviews.text:
I am a local charter captain and had some damage to my hull that needed fixed before I could get back in the water. Capt. Levi’s was willing to get me in for repairs the same day and fixed the next day. The willingness to help a captain in need quickly was very very impressive. He is a man of his word and follows through with excellent results.
I highly recommend Capt. Levi’s for your gelcoat and fiberglass repair needs. I am totally satisfied with the work and sense of urgency to get me back on the water.

Capt. Brian Gearhart
Gulf Coastin Charters

reviews.name: Gena Keebler
reviews.text:
I found Capt Levi's through Angies List - where they received rave reviews. I initially had my 2007 19ft Boston Whaler Outrage detailed by Pristine Marine when I originally purchased the boat last year....what a joke. Like night and day between the 2 details although the price was the same. Capt Dave & Parker came by looked at my boat we agreed on a price and 2 days later she is sparkling! The boat has never looked better! They guys were really cool and they educated me on caring for my boat....great guys! I will continue to call them in the future. They do an outstanding and professional detail job and your boat will sparkle! Highly recommend.... Thanks guys!

Gena
St Pete, FL

reviews.name: Mitch Law
reviews.text: I live in Seminole Fl. Have been a. Boat owner my whole life. I recently was referred to Captain Levis fiberglass repair and detail. My experience with him and his employees was second to none. Not only did they solve all my issues but even saved me a lot of money. Other estimates were considerably higher. I highly recommend them. They have my buisness from now on.

reviews.name: Nigel Wright
reviews.text: Captain Dave was a pleasure to deal with. He and his team did a fantastic job of repairing gelcoat gouges on my Chaparral boat. He responded quickly, the quality of the work was awesome and the cost was very reasonable. Highly recommended!

reviews.name: Branton Cooke
reviews.text: I had almost given of hope of finding someone to repair/replace the floor in my 24' Four Winns. I had several different fiberglass repair companies tell me that it was not worth the repair and to buy a new boat. What they could not understand is that I absolutely love the hull of my boat and bought it to completely customize the inside layout. Then, I discovered Captain Dave of Captain Levi's. He not only thought the project would be fun, but was also able to tell me all of the positives as opposed to everyone else. He has taken the plans that I had for the boat and turned them into reality. And not only has he done more than I could have imagined, but has done it all for a very reasonable cost. He has been completely willing to work with me to save as much money as possible and not sacrificing the quality of work at the same time. I can tell you that I not only give him my highest of recommendations, but I for one will never let anyone touch my boat but Captain Dave! Thank you for everything Captain Dave! Your work is amazing!

reviews.name: Eddie Fernandez
reviews.text:
Wow am i glad i found this shop. I broke my transom on a 21 foot deck boat. I spoke with Captain Dave about it and brought it in for him to see it. He not only gave me a fair price, but had the work done in 4 days time. Great shop! Great guys! Excellent work!! The new transom is solid as a rock and better than from factory.

If you need any fiberglass, transom work, boating accidents or restoration done, go see Captain Dave.

reviews.name: Stephanie Adelson
reviews.text: We visited Captain Levi for the first time in January 2013. We brought my son's racing sailboat in for repair - with 2 large holes. Captain Levi helped me call the manufacturer to make sure we used the correct fiberglass and he matched the colors of the boat perfectly. He also expedited the repair so we could be ready for our next race. I will actually be returning to him this week as we sustained a little damage in the Labor Day Regatta. I highly recommend his services.

reviews.name: R L
reviews.text:
Captain Dave and team do great honest work. The best part about going there was like seeing and old time friend. Instead of just dropping the boat and doing paperwork. Capt Dave shared a very amazing story about he got into fiberglass. We both were laughing before I realized I've already took 90 mins out of his time. A+ work extremely humble and kind. Highly recommend to anyone who made an "oops" or perhaps in my case a bad dealer install of a simrad thru hull transducer and some quality fiberglass issues in the head.

Although I never hope to need their services again I'm certain he will be "standing by" and ready to help! Thanks so much Dave and team!

reviews.name: JB
reviews.text: I went to inquire about my scratches in Gel coat. Captain Dave is a very knowledgeable person, he inspected the damaged areas of my boat. He explained issue and told me what needs to be done. He is really down to earth, It was a great experience, great conversation. Would definitely go back again for all my fiberglass Gel Coat repair needs.

reviews.name: Roosevelt Glenn
reviews.text: Great Service.During a Kayaking trip I punctured the Gel Coat of my fiberglass kayak. Bill Jackson's recommended I take my kayak over to Captain Levi. I was very impressed with Captain Levi's knowledge and experience with dealing with fiberglass repair. Kind and friendly service, my kayak is smooth to the touch. I highly recommend Captain Levi for any Kayak repair needs. Amanda G.

reviews.name: Steve Levie
reviews.text: I can not recommend Capt Dave and Captain Levi’s Boat Repair highly enough. Recently I was helping a friend who had had damage to their swim platform and needed it repaired. Based upon reviews I contacted Capt Levi’s, they absolutely bent over backwards to help my friend with their problem. Very, responsive, efficient,reasonable and knowledgeable. Beyond that they were just very nice people to do business with. These are definitely the guys to call.

reviews.name: Steve Sanders
reviews.text: Had a very good experience doing business with captain Levis. We had fail damage after a docking mishap and, after captain Dave dealt with our insurance company the boat was totally repaired and came back to us as good as knew. I highly recommend Captain Levis for any fiberglass boat repair you may need.

reviews.name: Nick Fraser
reviews.text: I had some severe fiberglass damage to my boat and no idea who to go to. After reading the reviews on this forum, I decided to call Captain Levis, and I'm glad I did. Capt. Dave handled all of the communication with the insurance company and even met with the surveyor to ensure they were all on the same page. My boat looks good as new. and I'd refer anyone to Captain Levis Fiberglass Repair.

reviews.name: Terry Tripp
reviews.text: Knowledgeable, and very helpful. Gave me all the info I need and answered all of my questions. I will definitely be back.

reviews.name: Roger In FL
reviews.text:
Spoke with Capt Dave today about a used boat I was looking to buy which had a crack in the hull and a couple other issues. Capt Dave was very honest and upfront about costs even going out of his way to put me in touch with other people who could answer my questions about mechanical issues. Was really great to talk with him, felt he was completely honest and fair. Would/will do business with him in the future.

Amended:
Bought a different boat, after 4 years of use, I had a brain cramp while trailering boat, hit a pole near a gas pump. smh. I remembered how Capt Dave helped me out in the past so I gave them a call. As before, they are really good people who do great work, fixed my "accident" so well I can't even tell it happened! Got me in and out in a few days too! Highly recommend these guys, you won't be disappointed.

reviews.name: Chris C
reviews.text: These folks are awesome. They are true craftsmen who takes pride in their work. I had my boat repaired in the past at a supposed fiberglass shop but found they used putty to fix the keel. Capt. Dave sent me pictures of the problem; the repairs and the finished product spoke for itself. Suzy did the best detailing job the boat has ever had. Highly recommend them.

reviews.name: Ryan Bales
reviews.text:
Hi I am Ryan.
I have been a Tech support in the fiberglass and composites industry for over 15 years.
When it comes to fiberglass boat repair in Florida one name stands out from the rest: Captain Levi's.
The principal and CEO Captain David Holley has over 53 years of experience under his belt. From heavy collision damage to gelcoat color matching, mold and plug building, custom fabrication, the Captain and his crew can do it all.
They provide great customer service and top quality work year in and year out.

reviews.name: k o
reviews.text: I have been a boat owner for 45 years and have dealt with all types of boat repair shops over the years. I can say without a doubt the Captain Levi's is the most honest and down to earth shop I have ever experienced. I took my boat to Capt. Levi expecting to have the transom replaced after he did a free inspection he told me I didn't need a new transom and didn't try to sell me any other services. This is something you don't see everyday a truly honest man. Capt. Levi's is at least an hour drive from me but if I ever need any repairs I will be going back. I also am planning to have them detail my boat after I repower. I have never written a review before but I think this is well deserved and I hope it helps someone else who is in need of an honest boat repair shop.

reviews.name: Derrick Lewis
reviews.text: I found Captain Levi through google while trying to get some gelcoat repaired on my boat. Captain Levi asked me to email pics of the damage, which I did, and I received a quote the same day. He was able to get my boat in within a few days and had the repair done in a couple of days. The repair turned out perfect and the price was fair. If you are looking to get work done by a local business that you can trust, look no further. I will be taking my boats to Captain Levi for years to come.

reviews.name: Kamal Bardouni
reviews.text: Amazing customer service, extremely quick turnaround time, emailed a couple pictures and was quoted very fast. Captain Levi is a great guy and takes care of his customers truly. I couldn’t recommend him enough.

reviews.name: Bob D
reviews.text: I highly recommend Captain Levis! Captain Dave is very knowledgeable and an interesting guy to talk to. He enlarged an existing hole in my center console to accommodate an new compass. The job took longer than anticipated however the quoted price was what was charged. He will be my go to for any future fiberglass work.

reviews.name: Wayne LeRoux
reviews.text:
My 28 foot Formula was launched from its lift when a lightning storm activated the lift. I was away for the summer and had removed the drain plugs so the rain water could escape. Not good though when the boat got launched unattended. The boat was rubbing against the neighbor's barnacle covered pilings for about four hours before salvage.

Captain Levi and his crew completely restored the glass and paint to absolutely new condition. Additionally he had his crew detailed the interior that was covered in greasy hand prints from the salvors. Highly recommend Captain Levi's.

Thanks Captain

reviews.name: Brian Reagan
reviews.text: Like most of us boaters, I prefer my boat to look perfect and like most boaters we screw up big time now and again. That is where Captain Dave comes in. He and his crew have the incredible craftsmanship to make it all seem like it never happened. You can see the scratches down my Starboard quarter just below the boarding door. A serious blemish that was remedied in short order. Captain Dave and his crew, Darren and Peter all showed up on time and went straight to work. Captain Dave did the color match and discussed the details with Darren and Peter who went to work laying in new glass sanding and gel coating. When the buffing was done all I could say was “what repair” because you can’t tell there ever was anything wrong. Incredible job, I could not be more pleased. I will definitely use there services again.

reviews.name: TheWrap Element
reviews.text:
We are wrapping a 28ft parasail boat and had to have the whole boat sanded to gel coat. Captain Levi and his team did an excellent job and created a smooth surface for our boat wrap. Captain Levi is very knowledgeable and offers great customer service. You get what you pay for and captain Levi's prices are not cheap but well worth the peace of mind!

Thank you captain Levi.

reviews.name: Joyce McCrary
reviews.text: My fiberglass mailbox needed repainting and I could not find anyone who wanted to bother with such a small job, but not Capt. Dave. They did a great job and mailbox looks brand new. He was a pleasure to deal with, and I would definitely recommend going to Capt. Levi's for any and all fiberglass painting and repair.

reviews.name: Muhammad Ahsan
reviews.text: Called to ask about a quote on getting fiberglass and cockpit repaired. The owner, who answered, was extremely rude. Told him I had pictures from my surveyor I could send him. He told me they don’t give quotes because they “don’t work for free.” Since when is providing a quote free labor? He essentially told me they charge 185 per hour. I asked how many hours to give a quote and he basically told me could be a couple hours or 100 hours. Useless douchebag. Wouldn’t last a single day working for me.

reviews.name: Terry Schmidt
reviews.text: I recently took my father's 1994 17' Cobia to Capt. Levi's for minor gel-coat repair & detailing. The boat had never been waxed and has been outdoors uncovered for 20 years. Sandy is awesome! The boat came back immaculate and the gel-coat shines like new. The price was very reasonable and they even fixed and cleaned areas that I didn't expect. It's refreshing to see a business take that much pride in their work. By the way, I drove over an hour each way during rush hour from Lakeland with no regrets. They have earned my and all my friend's business for all future fiberglass needs.

reviews.name: John Hughes
reviews.text: This is the guy! You've been looking for him: honest, dependable, friendly, experienced, and a real expert on boats and boat repair. Captain Dave was highly recommended to me, so after a short telephone conversation about some problems we've been having with our boat, he drove down to O'Neill's on a Saturday morning and spent over 2 hours going over the boat - including a sea trial. He was outstanding! I'm sold - Captain Dave is now "my boat guy."

reviews.name: Carol S
reviews.text:
5 STAR PLUS! Capt Levi’s is the go-to place for fiberglass and boat upkeep. We purchased a used boat in need of repair. After speaking with Capt Dave, we texted them pictures of our boat and they said to bring it down the following day. We had the following repairs performed:

•	Re-glass an 8 inch “L” shaped crack.
•	Re-gel and coat all damaged areas and match the colors.
•	Gelcoat restoration on all faded areas of the boat.

The craftsmanship was astonishing, the price quoted was extremely reasonable, and the work was performed in the stated timeframe. You will be well-served by their knowledgeable and talented team:

•	Jose – Gelcoat Finisher
•	Fedil – Boat Detailer
•	Allie – Fiberglass repair

It was such a pleasant professional business experience that we are taking our current boat back to them for some repairs.

reviews.name: Justin Bonner
reviews.text: Yamaha Fx cruiser Ho had some hull damage.. after taking it to executive marine, who failed to do the repair correctly the first time and the terrible paint job they left me with. I came across mr levi and his boat repair. He’s done the job right the first time around. The paint job is ridiculous you couldn’t even tell it was blended or repainted. Totally recommend if you want the repair done right the first time! Very friendly gentleman who cares about his customers.

reviews.name: Alan Moore
reviews.text: Found these guys on the internet and they did not disappoint. Captain Dave was an extremely huge help with my insurance claim and was very easy to work with. The work was preformed in a timely manner with fair pricing and looks amazing. Would definitely recommend to anyone looking for fiberglass/gel coat work in the St. Pete area.

reviews.name: Tyrone Baird
reviews.text:
Unfortunately my experience with this business does not match the general overall reviews received. Customer service is severely lacking.

I reached out to Captain Levi's for help with fiberglass repair, he promptly responded, asking to provide images of the damage, which I immediately did. That's as far as we ever got. Captain Levi at some point in our exchanges (mostly via text messages) either realized the job wasn't worth his time or maybe he was just having communications difficulties but either way. He completely stopped responding to my texts or phone calls.

The last communication I received was of him saying he was trying to get the color codes for the repair, but after almost a month later, and several follow ups on my side, I never heard anything back. I'm not sure what's going on with the communication but a simple response to any one of my attempts to reach out would be better than nothing at all.

reviews.name: Mike Wilhite
reviews.text: Captain Levi and Sandy did a great job of repairing my hull gel coat and non skid deck. They match the colors perfect (using computer - not by eyeballing it) and finished the repair like new. You can not tell where the repair was done! Would recommend them if you want the repair done right!

reviews.name: Kevin Campbell
reviews.text: Took my Boat to Capetian Levi's, and Captain Dave was very professional. He provided a wealth of great information, and did a spectacular job on the repairs. I would recommend Captain Levi's Fiberglass Boat Repair to anyone needing repairs. Great Job!!!

reviews.name: Michael Kulik
reviews.text: Have an 1987 17’ whaler that had a crack on the deck of the boat that was very close to the non skid. Captain Dave and his team did an awesome job on the repair. Would never know there was damage to the boat and the color match is perfect. Very professional and fair. Would highly recommend.

reviews.name: Cynthia Pollock
reviews.text: I had Captain Levi's repair my captain chairs to the floor and repair my floor hatch I was so worried it was going to be "break out another thousand" but I was estatic when the repair was less than half of that. I was told it would probably be a few days to repair. I was so happy when they called later that day and it was done. I would totally refer them to everyone who has a boat and I will defiantly use them again. One happy lady here😃🚤

reviews.name: Aramis Landrau
reviews.text: Unless you want to be ignored or waste your time trying to get your watercraft in for service, DONT USE THESE GUYS! Fist impressions over the phone, I thought these guys were the ones that would handle my repairs. Captain Dave sounded like he knew what he was talking about. Unfortunately after setting an appointment to drop off my Ski I never heard back from captain Dave or captain Levi. I showed up for my drop off and no body was there, waited 45mins while calling them multiple times too never receive a call back. I still considered using them but these guys never even called to gain my business. It was very disappointing having gone down to stpete to be stood up by these guys.

reviews.name: Evan Forte
reviews.text: Captain Levi's repaired a sizable puncture in the fiberglass hull of our Yamaha jet boat. Not only did they do quality work which makes the original blemish invisible, they were extremely friendly and performed the work very quickly. If I need fiberglass repair again I will not hesitate to give them a call.

reviews.name: Dwight Ruppert
reviews.text: Minor hull damage was repaired to like-new condition very timely and at a reasonable rate. Captain Dave was very responsive and provided clear communication. He even completed the work under the original quote, which is very rare! I hope to never need his services again, but I'm extremely satisfied. He's an artist and a pleasure to work with!

reviews.name: Fortes Inboard Connection Tige Boats
reviews.text:
Dave Holley of Captain Levi's Fiberglass Boat Repair is by far the most knowledgable of his trade. Repair work is top quality. Call response time is quick and efficient. We use him for all our fiberglass repair needs. Knows his stuff and gets the work done when you need it. Comes through in the most curtail of times to save the day when the boat needs to be done asap. We recommend him for everyones fiberglass repair needs.

Tony Forte
Forte's Inboard and Auto Connection

reviews.name: Anne Denny
reviews.text: Captain Dave and crew are excellent. They offer you choices. They removed the carpeting from my 1995 chaparral and put down a nonstick floor and sides to match my boat. Awesome job. Repaired the chairs and replaced the pedestals. Then buffed out the gel coat. Looks like new. Thank you Capt.

reviews.name: Darren Ghanayem
reviews.text: I had a cracked in the hull of my Yamaha wave runner and was very concerned about how to deal with this. These guys were great and did exactly what they said they’d do. They communicated with me through the process and finished the job ahead of schedule. I wouldn’t hesitate to recommend them to anyone…honest / good people.

reviews.name: Connor Phares
reviews.text: These guys are great! I had a jet ski with a mess of cracks through the hull and no one wanted to mess with it, then I heard about Captain Levi’s. Brought them my ski and they turned it around quicker than I thought. Can’t even tell there was ever any damage. I manage a boat and jet ski rental and we will be coming back! Highly recommend!

reviews.name: Raphael Jimenez II
reviews.text: CPT Levi's fiberglass boat repair service is beyond phenomenal. His attention to detail, customer service, flexibility are unquestionable. He was able to help me get my boat repaired while I traveled and was ready for pick up once I arrived. He is a straight foward gentlemen with no hidden fees and stands behind his work. The final product was so perfect I could not see the paint change or blend and trust me I'm a big super car guy and can discover a bad paint job immediately. Lastly, I highly and strongly reccomend CPT Levis Boat Repair to take on the most difficult and largest repairs and he won't let you down. Thanks CPT Levi !!!

reviews.name: Kyle Thomas
reviews.text: The crew at Captain Levi's was very flexible in coordinating a drop-off time for my 24' center console to get detailed. They were also accommodating when determining whether to trailer the boat to them or meet them at Bay Pines. My boat had quite a bit of oxidation as well as tanic stain on the bottom and they were able to clear all of that up. Pricing was fair, quality was high, and the staff was very friendly.

reviews.name: Sam Miller
reviews.text:
I recently bought a used 18' Stingray bowrider. It had been sitting on a lift for several years, and was pretty neglected. I asked around the beaches, looking for someone to detail the boat. Captain Dave was recommended to me, and I gave him a call. I didn't have a trailer hitch on my car yet, and Captain Dave accommodated me by picking up the boat. He took it to his boatyard, where he and Christine started working on it. He called me after a couple of days, and said "come look at it". I couldn't believe I was looking at the same boat. Instead of looking dull, and neglected, it was shining in the sun! The oxidation was gone, and it almost looked new!! I was very pleased with the result, and the price was right.

If you need detailing, or fiberglass work done on your boat, Take it to Captain Dave, his son Captain Levi, and their staff. You won't be disappointed!!

Sam Miller, Redington Beach Fl.

reviews.name: Richard Davis
reviews.text: David Holley of Captain Levi's Fiberglass Boat Repair is one of the finest of his trade. He is extremely knowledgeable in regards to all aspects of fiberglass boat building and repair. His quality of work is unsurpassed, for remarkable repairs and beautiful craftsmanship he is the one to call on.

reviews.name: Wyatt Spruill
reviews.text:
Capt'n Dave and his crew did an amazing job fixing the gel coat damage I had. I also had them buff out the oxidation on the upper hull while they had it, looks like new again. I could not be happier.
Highly recommended!

reviews.name: Jake Lavagnino
reviews.text: Contacted originally for the repair, still waiting for it to be completed even after asked for payment. Made the payment. Attempted to contact response. I’m sure their work is better than what they have provided

reviews.name: Mick Loren
reviews.text:
Had a soft flooring issue with my 2000 Scarab 302...After getting some insane estimates, my buddy advised me to call Capt Dave and talk to him...After speaking to Capt Dave and having him come out and look at my boat, we decided the best recourse would be to try the new injection filler process directly into the floor to fix the soft spots... I can honestly say that this process worked the best of any of the others that I had considered and the cost savings to me were so much, that I installed a brand new SeaDek floor to cover the small holes...The work was excellent and dealing with Capt Dave was a pure pleasure!!..I recommended Capt Dave to a close friend who was having the same issue and his results were identical...Thanks Capt Dave for the excellent service!!

Mike Lorenzo

reviews.name: Jessica Grams
reviews.text: Captain is the best around. Highly recommend, very professional and works in a timely manner

reviews.name: Bada Bing Water Sports
reviews.text: We are a Water Sports Company in Downtown St. Petersburg and we get incredible service from Captain Dave and his team. They take care of all 11 our of wave runners these guys can repair anything. Our customers get to enjoy strong and safe equipment, We highly recommend this company and they have a great facility to work in, communication is great, all around great experience working with this company for the past year and will continue to.

reviews.name: Martin Cohen
reviews.text: The Captain took really good care of me and the follow up was appreciated. Roy came out to my home to repair my shower base did a phenomenal job. He was clean , professional and expedient and the price was right. Hope I don’t need them again but if I do this is the place to call. Marty Cohen

reviews.name: arn hub
reviews.text:
Lord knows I tried to work with this guy, way over a year and had to take my boat back in pieces. Always BS on top of BS why he needed more money and why it wasn't done.
To anyone who might think of trusting him I suggest you take a good look at him and the many fellows who also live in the attic of the building. That's not a joke. Sometimes people are what they look to be.

Sure wish someone would have warned me and I had taken the time to look for criminal records.

I do have to hand it to old Dave, he is really good at the game!

reviews.name: Marilyn Ward
reviews.text: Have a Paddle Yak tandem kayak that I thought had gelcoat damage from being tied down too tightly. Took to Captain Levi's for repairs. They were very thorough in finding underlying structural issues that caused gelcoat to crack, and in fixing multiple areas at a reasonable price. Did a good job explaining what was done. Had boat in time for a race, too!

reviews.name: GulfCoastTrawler
reviews.text: captain levi's team did a great job on my hatteras. the deck was soft and now it is better than new, and they did it for less money than their competition. head man captain dave is a colorful waterfront character and you will enjoy doing business with him. i recommend captain levi's highly and would definitely hire them again.

reviews.name: Bob Bob
reviews.text: Spoke to Cap'n Dave on the phone, got the impression this Ole salty dog knows his business. They fixed up a fish box hatch for me and it's good as new now. Fair price and quality work done fast. You can't beat that. Thanks again!

reviews.name: Christopher Cservak
reviews.text: Excellent work great honesty and my boat looked like brand new when it was brought back to me captain Levi is a true man of his word

reviews.name: Bryson S.
reviews.text: I needed a new auto-bailer drain tube installed between the bilge and the outside scupper. Captain Dave, Too-Tall Dave, and Darin, were great to work with. They got the right parts, did excellent work, were very knowledgeable and the price was fair. They also completed the job the same day that I brought it in. Thank you, guys!

reviews.name: owen deck
reviews.text: Fast fare and does great work. Did an outstanding job of restoring my old Whaler. Highly recommend using Capt Levi for you gel coat and fiberglass work.

reviews.name: steven staton
reviews.text: My experience with Captain Levi was very positive. They were able to diagnose the problem with my Mako's hull and repair it on a timely basis. Great "old Florida" business.

reviews.name: JOHN QUINN
reviews.text: The Captian detailed my 1998 hull and made it look great. Highly recommend these guys!!

reviews.name: Jesse K
reviews.text: This is the fastest turnaround time i've had in the boating industry. I called captain levi mid-week, sent him pictures, he replied with a estimate, dropped it off saturday and the job was done by sunday. Great service.

reviews.name: Stan Martin
reviews.text: Very honest!! Thought I had big problems with a cracked transom. They went to the marina to inspect the boat and rather than lying to me that I needed a $4k transom rebuild, they said cracks were only cosmetic in nature and could wait to be fixed. Will definitely use them when I have the non-skid redone and when I fix the cosmetic stuff this winter.

reviews.name: Marc Wheeler
reviews.text: Absolutely FANTASTIC work on a very dirty boat. My Dusky 256 hadn't been touched in 3 years of sitting outside on a lift. After four days of very hard and dedicated cleaning, it's been brought back to near-new condition. I couldn't be happier.

reviews.name: Evan Lefsky
reviews.text: Captain Dave did a great job repairing the gel coat on my Sailfish 275. He really took the time to make sure the job was done right and even provided some great fishing tips.

reviews.name: Mike Parks
reviews.text:
Caution: You will want to damage your boat again to revist. Haha Great guys that do great work!!!

Captain Levi's got me my wrecked boat back in record time looking better than when I bought it.

reviews.name: Jeff Murphy
reviews.text: Very happy with the work done. Great communicating from start to finish. Did the work in very timely manner and made it effortless for me the customer as they did the interaction with the insurance adjuster. Thanks Captain Tom for all you do.

reviews.name: Jennifer Knibbs
reviews.text: I was very happy with the work. My overall experience was extremely good. I would use Captain Levis again.

reviews.name: Roger Dickert
reviews.text: Capt Dave did a great job on my boat , have used different guys in past and in different in different states , always the same , 2 weeks means 2 months or longer but not with Capt Dave , I was shocked when he called me 2 weeks weeks later and said boat was done and actually for price he quoted , he will be the only one who I bring my boats to for any fiberglass work

reviews.name: Shakspeat
reviews.text: Captain Levi did a great job repairing the damage to the gel coat on my boat. Customer service was great. Glad I was able to find him again.

reviews.name: Jeff Miller
reviews.text: Captain Dave and his team are truly craftsman and Old School experts at what they do. If you’re cool enough and fortunate to catch them at the right time, you may get them to tell you some stories and tales of Florida of yester year. Love these guys!!

reviews.name: Christopher Lesnewski
reviews.text: Captain David Holley & his crew are Aces! They have done a righteous job on my 1966 28' Hatteras. Long restoration, but she is almost finished.

reviews.name: Jared Heiser
reviews.text: I recommend Captain Levi. I had found some rot in my transom and was trying to determine my options. He advised me honestly for free and saved me from wasting a lot of money and time. He is very honest and forthcoming even if that means he won't get your business. Very rare to find business owners like him. I will definitely give him business in the future.

reviews.name: Jeffrey Roy
reviews.text:
I have used Captain Levi's, in assistance when searching for a "New to us" Center Console. Their knowledge, professionalism, patience and genuine kindness, is to be recognized.

That said, they now have a customer for life!!

reviews.name: Danny Stephen
reviews.text: Capt. Levi's fiberglass repair did a unusual fiberglass repair for my young sons racing go kart body. One of his karts is wider than the most common available. We could not find a body made that was wide enough to completely keep the tires/wheels inside bodywork. We needed the body wide enough and strong enough to keep the tires/wheels from protruding outside of bodywork. At 70 plus MPH the last thing you want is your front tire touching someones back tire. When that happens, The kart now becomes an airplane. Capt. Levis cut the body in half, widened it 3", and reglassed and also reformed the nose to curve back in. Not only is the body extra strong now but it also looks like a prefabed kart body and fits great. Capt.Dave who performed the work, is a pleasure to do business with, easy to get a hold of and works with ethics not found much anymore. His "old school" ethics and handshake business dealings are rare and we certainly got a great job and also a great friend now. Danny and Jude Stephen Current "Florida Oval Asphalt Division" JR1 Points Champion and DirtDevilsSpeedway JR1 Sportsman Points Leader, and Crossroads Motorplex SuperSpeedway 1/4 mile Asphalt Track unofficial JR2 Track Record holder 14.29 Seconds...............Jude is an 8yr. old Boy by the way accomplishing this.

reviews.name: Chris Rosende
reviews.text: These guys are as nice as can be. They repaired my floor in my boat, fixed some hatches, and were done in a couple of days. Fair pricing and great communication. I was impressed for sure.

reviews.name: BOBBY SPRUILL
reviews.text: Capt Dave does exceptional work, always a pleasure to work with! Thanks for taking care of our boat!

reviews.name: Kimmarie Lahey
reviews.text: Capt Dave is absolutely an awesome guy to work with. Very friend and gets the job done. I never had an issue here or a complaint, I love working with them.

reviews.name: Ron
reviews.text: Worked with Captain Levi's for gelcoating. Was very pleased with the work that was completed on time and on budget. Captain Dave and crew are efficient. I would recommend them.

reviews.name: Miranda Stoll
reviews.text: For a small family owned and operated shop, this is by far the best shop! Reasonably low prices for 5 star work. Ide recommend this place to anyone and everyone. Very nice people and they actually take pride in their work. They do it all. Best boat repair shop in the area!

reviews.name: Bruce Pritchard
reviews.text:
excellent repair, took extra time to make it perfect, you can not tell where there was any damage. still kept the original price quoted. would highly recommend to any one.
i am a very fussy boat owner, my oceanmaster looks new again. thank capt. levi
bruce

reviews.text: These guys did a great job with the repairs and touch ups that my boat needed. Very honest and easy to work with. Highly recommend!

reviews.text: Captain Levi's Fiberglass is an excellent fiberglass repair company. They are very friendly and their work is great!

reviews.name: Cliff G
reviews.text: I'm new to the boat world trying to repair my 12.5 skiff Captian Dave helped with all my questions to make sure I was repairing it the right way so I would be safe on the water. Thank you again for taking time out of your day to help!!!!

reviews.name: Boomer
reviews.text: Really friendly staff! Very reliable and great work, happy to have worked with Capt Dave, a real pleasure!

reviews.name: Jazz Burns
reviews.text:
Outstanding Service, Genuine Care, and a Captain Who Goes Above and Beyond!

This was my first experience dealing with a boat repair company, and I honestly couldn't have asked for a better one!

From the very first phone call, the Captain made me feel like I was talking to an uncle from up the street, someone I'd known for 20 years! His welcoming personality, honesty, and professionalism immediately put me at ease about having my swim deck repaired.

What impressed me even more was his attention to detail. While working on my swim deck, he noticed some fiberglass chipping away near my transom. Without hesitation, he repaired it **at no additional charge!** He told me, "The Captain doesn't leave a stone unturned," and made it clear that he wasn't going to leave his beautiful work sitting next to something that needed attention. That alone spoke volumes about his pride in his craftsmanship.

Throughout the repair process, I was also waiting on a mechanical part and had a few other things that needed attention. One weekend, his technician happened to be in the area and went out of his way to help me with an anchor issue and the installation of my new transom lights. Again, just another example of a team that genuinely cares about its customers.

It's rare these days to find people who treat your property as if it were their own and make you feel more like family than just another customer.** The Captain and his crew did exactly that!

If your vessel needs repairs, **PLEASE give the Captain and his team a call!** They will make what could be a stressful experience much easier, go above and beyond what you expect, and even share a few valuable boating tips and pointers along the way.

Captain, thank you and your entire crew for the outstanding service, generosity, and genuine care you showed me and my boat. You've earned my trust, my appreciation, and my future business. I highly recommend you to any fellow boater!

J.Burns
36 ft Vessel

reviews.name: Greg Polyakov
reviews.text:
I just got off the phone with the team at Captain Levi’s after emailing them photos of a small crack in my boat’s hull. Rather than trying to sell me an unnecessary repair, they took the time to review the photos and reassured me that it wasn’t something I needed to address right now, if ever. They simply recommended keeping an eye on it and giving them a call if it worsens.

It’s clear that honesty, integrity, and their customers’ best interests come before making a sale. They earned my trust without charging me a dime, and if I ever need fiberglass work, I know exactly who I’ll be calling first. Highly recommend!

reviews.name: Scott Maxwell
reviews.text:
Had a couple of chips in my Gelcoat , spoke with Captain Dave who was an absolute pleasure to talk to and extremely knowledgeable. Super generous with his time !
Capt sent one of his guys “ Golden “ over to take care of the repairs. Well let’s just say he had some challenges getting everything matched correctly in the first few trips BUT …. Golden never quit , he was very frustrated expressed his embarrassment and apologized multiple times. Golden made an appointment for every trip back he kept those appointments ( on his own TIME ! ) every time !
I just can’t say enough about Golden’s determination Integrity and can do attitude. I’m sure when Golden first arrived he probably thought he would make quick work on these 2 small chips it just didn’t work out that way this time. Thanks to Golden for having such a great work ethic and pride in what he does !
At the end of the day my boat looks great and met someone who I can trust.
Definitely recommend Captain Levi’s for any of your boat work especially if his other guys are like Golden , can’t go wrong.

reviews.name: Cheryl Pearson
reviews.text: Our boat looked like new when Dave was finished. He is a great guy…man of integrity that does a great job for a fair price. Don’t take your boat to a big service facility that charges you for average work….go to Captain Levi’s for personal service and someone who is detail oriented.
